description: This PHP file defines the SaveProjectController class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The class manages project-saving functionalities, including preparing the UI component for project creation or editing and validating user permissions for project access. It interacts with project data, user roles, and HTTP requests to facilitate project management in the HRM system.

classes.name: SaveProjectController
classes.description: A controller class for saving and editing project data within the OrangeHRM time tracking module. It prepares UI components for project creation or editing and checks user permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for project creation or editing based on request attributes, including project ID and associated activity IDs.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access or modify the specified project based on its ID.
